suggested_requirements.text: The system shall process science data from the camera and relay it to the Spacecraft Control Unit in the form of CCSDS Source Packets.
The system shall receive commands from the Spacecraft Control Unit that establish the current instrument state and camera mode.
The system shall transmit detailed housekeeping data to the Spacecraft Control Unit in the form of CCSDS Source Packets.
The system shall receive a time message from the Spacecraft Control Unit and synchronize the XCP local copy of the spacecraft clock.
The system shall control the heaters on the telescope tube and on the thermal baffles.
The system shall read the Telescope Alignment Monitor.
The system shall generate an XRT Position message to UVOT and TDRSS within 1200 seconds of a burst alert.
The system shall produce a Postage Stamp Report and transmit it via TDRSS within 1200 seconds of a burst alert.
The system shall produce a Spectrum Report and transmit it to TDRSS within 1200 seconds of a new burst.
The system shall perform Built-In Test Stage 1 during the boot state.
The system shall perform Built-In Test Stage 2 during the initialization state.
The system shall reject commands received in the RED state that are not RED commands.
